designationHistory.indexText: Grand Cote National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1989 to provide valuable waterfowl habitat in the Mississippi/Red River floodplain as part of the North American Waterfowl Management Plan.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
